summary: Adopt Factory provision manifests and build-only CI under .unfogy/woodpecker.
breaking: Woodpecker must use .unfogy/woodpecker/. Factory reads provision.yaml and repository.yaml, not the former Control config or embedded provision section. Existing deployments and provider settings are unchanged; merge and inspected provider reconfiguration are required before use. Starter placeholders must be rebound to an admitted project. No SQL migration is introduced.
